thread:
Priya (oncall): quick handoff — leaving in 10. Main things: pool-gamma at 78% steady, small ~20 req/s burst yesterday at 02:10 UTC from cust-phi. Keeping an eye on queue length for long jobs.
Sam: noted. any scheduled batch jobs tonight?
Priya (oncall): yes — data-team scheduled a nightly eval at 02:00 UTC (small) and infra scheduled model-a reindex at 03:30 UTC (longer, uses 2x batch). both in RINF-451.
Josh: thanks. current headroom metric?
Priya (oncall): headroom ~22% on pool-gamma, aggregated GPU slots free = 6. Predicted drop to ~10% if both jobs overlap.
Anika: are autoscale policies active for gamma? last I saw burst_limit was 30 concurrent.
Priya (oncall): autoscale active. burst_limit=30, reserved_guarantee=10. If we hit burst_limit, routing will spill to pool-beta (higher cost) not ideal.
Sam: small ask — can you lower burst_limit to 24 for the 01:45–04:30 window to avoid oversubscribe?
Priya (oncall): I can do that before I sign off. Running command now: `rictl pools update pool-gamma --burst-limit 24 --window '2026-03-18T01:45Z/2026-03-18T04:30Z'`
ops-bot: autoscale policy updated for pool-gamma by Priya. New burst_limit=24 (effective now).
Josh: nice. reminder that cust-phi has a spike pattern every 7 days ~02UTC. Might coincide with evals.
Anika: good catch. Can we set a soft quota throttle for cust-phi for that window? `rictl quotas patch customer=phi --soft-throttle 0.6 --until 2026-03-18T05:00Z`
Priya (oncall): I'm adding the soft throttle now. ops-bot will confirm.
ops-bot: quota soft-throttle applied to customer=phi by Priya.
Sam: pinging @Josh to review the canary fallback route we discussed — we should make pool-beta fallback cheaper by adjusting kernel selection to use quantized variant if fallback happens.
Josh: acknowledged, I'll make a small runtime tweak after the reindex finishes. Low-risk, will monitor latency.
Priya (oncall): handoff checklist: 1) burst_limit lowered, 2) soft-throttle on cust-phi, 3) watch pool-gamma headroom, 4) alert if queue > 12 for > 5m (alert rule RINF-ops-queue).
Anika: I have the 00:00–08:00 shift, will keep an eye. If we see sustained >15% drop in headroom, I'll open a capacity swap ticket.
Priya (oncall): thanks — leaving my phone on. if anything spikes, escalate to me then to Josh if needed. :thumbsup:
Sam: all set, thanks Priya. :eyes:
Priya (oncall): signing off — good luck.
